The name is mentioned in some prophetic hadiths, lending it religious and spiritual significance in Islamic tradition. It connotes bravery, protection, and strength. Etymologically, it derives from the Arabic root 'k-sh-w' which relates to concepts of protection and defense. Historically, the name has been used in various Muslim cultures, symbolizing valor and guardianship
